instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Fusion Holdings operates a mid-sized fashion and apparel retail chain with 45 physical stores across key shopping malls in three countries. Utilizing an ultra-fast-fashion model, the company maintains a rapid 6-week design-to-shelf cycle. Current challenges include significant margin compression due to intense competition from online platforms and aggressive fast-fashion brands.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business—we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently experiencing high internal friction regarding cross-departmental alignment, which slows down the transition from project implementation to sustained innovation.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Optimized Inventory Flow via RFID Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Implementing the planned RFID integration will directly address current replenishment speed challenges and improve operational efficiency within existing retail channels. This is a low-risk, high-impact step that leverages existing infrastructure to secure immediate competitive advantage.

first_actions: Finalize vendor selection for RFID hardware compatibility
Define pilot store group (3 stores) and success metrics
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in stock-out rate by 15% within the pilot group
milestones: Q3: Hardware installation and system integration complete
Q4: Pilot data analysis and scalability report

opportunities.title: B2B Wholesale Curation Service Launch
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic need for diversification, this opportunity involves leveraging Fusion's brand and supply chain expertise to create a premium wholesale service for local boutique retailers. This moves revenue streams away from ultra-competitive fast fashion margins.

first_actions: Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) catalog
Identify 5 target B2B retail partners for pilot program
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 10 recurring wholesale contracts generating $50k in new revenue within the first year
milestones: Q3: MVP launch and initial pilot fulfillment
Q4: Achieve defined revenue target from B2B contracts

opportunities.title: Hyper-Localized Virtual Try-On Experience (AR)
opportunities.rationale: To address consumer behavior shifts and generate new digital value, developing an augmented reality tool for in-store or mobile virtual try-on could create a unique experiential differentiator. While requiring significant investment, this addresses the need for entirely new value propositions.

first_actions: Conduct user interviews to define feature set
Allocate seed budget for AR platform prototyping (8%)
resources_needed: Cloud infrastructure and development sprint allocation (5%)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10,000 virtual try-on sessions with a conversion rate of 3% to physical store visits
milestones: Year 2: Full commercial launch across key flagship stores

next_steps.action: Establish cross-functional innovation steering committee to align on diversification targets.
Initiate discovery phase for the B2B wholesale curation service, including market validation workshops.

key_weaknesses: Budget Constraint: The 10% budget allocation severely limits the scope and scale of major innovation bets, forcing reliance on low-cost incremental changes.
Process Bottlenecks: Formal governance structures are not fully established, leading to slow handoffs between idea generation and execution phases.
Talent Gap: Limited internal technical talent prevents dedicated teams from pursuing high-complexity radical initiatives without compromising core operations.
